alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued March 5 at 2:04AM CST by NWS Fort Worth TX
alerts.description:
At 203 AM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Callisburg, or 10 miles northwest of Whitesboro, moving northeast at
25 mph.

HAZARD...Winds in excess of 30 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

This strong thunderstorm will be near...
Lake Texoma around 210 AM CST.

Other locations impacted by this storm include Gordonville, Walnut
Bend, Sturgeon, Dexter, Sandusky, Sherwood Shores, and Dixie.
